C0589.title: Yan'an Yonghui Supermarket Xuanyuan Avenue Branch Price Fraud Case
C0589.summary: On August 31, 2021, Yan'an market regulators investigated a public complaint that Yonghui Supermarket's Xuanyuan Avenue branch kept promotional prices the same as non-promotional prices. The investigation found that the branch did not sell goods at the original prices shown on its price tags and fabricated original prices to commit price fraud. Regulators issued a warning and imposed a 100,000-yuan fine.
